## Analysis

I examined all 20 active SAE features for any encoding of gender markers (e.g., female pronouns, gendered terms, or other proxies for gender).

**No spurious gender-marker features were identified.** None of the active features promote tokens like "she," "her," "woman," "lady," or other gendered terms. The input text contains "She" pronouns, but no feature appears to encode these as classification signals.

The features do not exhibit the spurious pattern described in the concern.
